This is my first attempt at homemade bacon.

Started with pork belly from Costco ( I used 2 aprox. 2 lbs portions), not the best but good. Then i used a the cure below rinsed and dried the pork, and rubbed in the cure, let it sit in the fridge for 7 days (flipping it everyday) in a gallon ziplock. Then rinsed the cure off and dried it on a rack in the fridge for 2 days. and finally finished it in the oven at 200 until it reached an internal temp of 150. Awesome bacon and very easy to do.

Cure (this is per pound)

1 teaspoon of pink curing salt #2 1/2 cup Kosher coarse grind salt. 1/2 cup sugar 1/4 cup coarse ground pepper 1 teaspoon curry powder 1 teaspoon cumin 1 teaspoon coriander seeds 2 cloves of garlic crushed 1 bay leaf

U.S. scientists successfully turn human cancer cells back to normal in process that could 'switch off' disease

ELI5 Version:

Cells have a switch that tells them to stop reproducing to prevent them from going out of control and turning into bad stuff. Cancer cells have this switch permanently broken off so that they can't stop, and the uncontrolled reproduction makes cells grow in funky (bad funky) ways. Scientists have found a way to put that switch back on. Right now, they're finding better ways to give cells this switch.
